run_quantize_qwen3_mxfp8a16: run the script to quantize Qwen3-8B to MXFP8A16 and save the model
create_quantization_modifier: create a QuantizationModifier targeting Linear layers with MXFP8A16 scheme ignoring lm_head
apply_oneshot_quantization: apply oneshot quantization to a loaded model using a QuantizationModifier recipe
dispatch_quantized_model: dispatch a quantized model using compressed_tensors offload for inference
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format
